children: Erajaya Swasembada is benefiting from its new businesses, UOB Kay Hian analysts say in a research report. Its lifestyle arm Sinar Eka Selaras delivered same-store-sales growth of 7.7% for the first seven months of 2026, led by the Urban Republic, DJI and JD Sports brands, the analysts say. Chinese electric-vehicle maker XPeng, for which Sinar Eka Selaras is the Indonesian distributor, booked 1,682 units in first seven months of 2026. The brokerage lifts its 2026 and 2027 net profit estimates for the Indonesian company by 12% and 11%, respectively. It raises the stock's target price to 800.00 rupiah from 450.00 rupiah with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.9% higher at 580.00 rupiah. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
